answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every agent to lock a refundable stake before joining, like a jade seal that proves real commitment. Agents that misbehave forfeit the stake, so spawning thousands of fake identities becomes prohibitively expensive. Reputation then flows like a river: trust builds only through verified, useful work over time, and a newcomer standing in the frozen tundra of zero history cannot instantly borrow the standing of established agents, so the cost of forging identities exceeds any gain from gaming the system.
